properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 7 at 7:42AM CDT until August 7 at 11:45AM CDT by NWS Wichita KS
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Marion County in central Kansas...

* WHEN...Until 1145 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Low-water
crossings are inundated with water and may not be passable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 742 AM CDT, emergency management reported heavy rain in the
warned area due to thunderstorms. Flooding is already occurring.
Between 2 and 5 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible in the
warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Marion, Florence, Burns, Lincolnville, Ramona, Lost Springs and
Pilsen.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.areaDesc: Armstrong, PA; Indiana, PA; Jefferson, PA
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 7 at 9:28AM EDT until August 7 at 12:30PM EDT by NWS Pittsburgh PA
properties.description:
FFWPBZ

The National Weather Service in Pittsburgh has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Armstrong County in west central Pennsylvania...
Northwestern Indiana County in west central Pennsylvania...
Southwestern Jefferson PA County in west central Pennsylvania...

* Until 1230 PM EDT.

* At 928 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1.5 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Kittanning, Ford City, West Kittanning, Rural Valley, Worthington,
Dayton, West Hills, Manorville, Ford Cliff, Applewold, Lenape
Heights, Timblin, Templeton, Distant and Mahoning Creek Lake.

Significant rises on Pine Creek and Cowanshannock Creek may also
result in flooding, impacting areas within their flood plain.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 5 at 1:54PM AKDT until August 7 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Yentna River including Lake Creek.

* WHEN...Until 100 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Streams
continue to rise due to excess runoff from earlier rainfall.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 146 PM AKDT, river gauge reports indicate rises in water
levels from heavy rain across the warned area. Flooding is
ongoing. Between 1.5 and 3 inches of rain have fallen.
Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.25 inches are possible.
- For Yentna River at Lake Creek:
At 12:50pm the stage was 22.4 feet.
Flood Stage is 20.5 feet.
Forecast: A crest around 22.4 feet is expected around 4:00pm
Wednesday.
-The Yentna River at Lake Creek is forecast to go below flood
stage Saturday morning August 8th.

Impacts:
Between 21 and 22 feet, several lodges may have water in or
around low-lying cabins.




- Http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

properties.areaDesc: South Mobile Bay; Perdido Bay Area; Coastal waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS out 20 NM; Waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS from 20 to 60 NM
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 7 at 8:45AM CDT until August 7 at 10:15AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
SMWMOB

The National Weather Service in Mobile has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS out 20 NM...
Perdido Bay Area...
South Mobile Bay...
Waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1015 AM CDT.

* At 844 AM CDT, a strong thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located near Perdido Pass, moving west at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts 34 knots or greater, and small
hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Orange Beach, Sand Island Lighthouse, Gulf Shores Beach, Fort
Gaines, Fort Morgan, Farewell Buoy, and Perdido Pass.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

properties.description:
SVRICT

The National Weather Service in Wichita has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southwestern Chase County in east central Kansas...
Northeastern Butler County in south central Kansas...
Southeastern Marion County in central Kansas...

* Until 930 AM CDT.

* At 835 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line

HAZARD...Quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Damage to vehicles is expected.

* Locations impacted include...
El Dorado, Marion, Leon, Florence, Burns, Rosalia, Cassoday, Cedar

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Minor flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage this
evening and continue falling to 5.9 feet Wednesday morning.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.
